paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Sianthouna Leh Dikna Dante
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na siangthou ding uh ahi, Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka siangthou ngal a.
english: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I Yahweh your God am holy.

paite: "Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na siangthou ding uh ahi, Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka siangthou ngal a.
english: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Milim lam ah kihei kei unla, sunthoh milimte leng kibawltawm kei un. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "TOUPA a dia kilemna thillat na lat chiang un noumau deihtelna a na lat ding uh ahi.
english: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

paite: Na lat ni mah uh ahihkeileh azing a na nek ding uh ahi. Ani thum ni tan a, aval a-om laileh mei a na hal ding uh ahi.
english: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day: and if anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

paite: Ani thum ni tan a nek ahihleh thilkihhuai ahi a; pomsak ahi kei ding hi.
english: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

paite: Ane kuapeuh in TOUPA sianthouna ahihnit ziak in athulimlouhna moh akipuak dia, huai mi achipihte a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

paite: "Na lou ua buh na lak chiang un, lounawl zulte tan in na la vek ding uh ahi kei. Asang leng na zong ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

paite: Na grephuan uah asang na zong ding uh ahi kei. Na grephuan ua agah kia leng na tomkhawm ding uh ahi kei. Mizawng leh gamdangmi a ding in na hawisak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Na gu ding uh ahi kei. Atak lou in thil na hih ding ahi kei. Zuau na kihilhtuah ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

paite: Na Pathian min hemsak ding in ka min in dikloutak in na kichiam ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Na invengte na khem ding ahi kei. Na guksak ding leng ahi kei. Kilohmi loh zankhua in azingsang tan in na kem ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

paite: Nangong na hamsiat ding ahi kei. Mittaw ma ah apukna ding na koih ding ahi kei. Na Pathian na lauh ding ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Vaihawmna ah diktat loutak in thu na khen ding ahi kei. Mizawng na simmoh tuam ding ahi kei hi. Mi thilhihthei na zahtak tuam ding ahi kei. Himahleh diktattak in na invengte vai na hawmsak ding ahi.
english: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment: you shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

paite: Na chipihte lak ah migensia in na vialvak ding ahi kei. Na invengte sisan thu ah ahilou lam in na pang ding ahi kei. TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not go up and down as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life literally, “blood” of your neighbor. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Na lungtang in na unau na ho ding ahi kei. Na invengte na taihilh ngeingei ding ahi. Na huchihleh agitlouhna ah na siang ding hi.
english: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

paite: Phu na la ding ahi kei. Na chipihte suante huatna na pai ding ahi kei. Nang na ki-it bang in na invengte na it ding ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Ka thupiakte na zui ding uh ahi. Na ganta chi tuamtuam suangsak ke'n. Na lou ah haichi chi nih chingkhawm ke'n. Thil chituam nih gatpolh puan na silh ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not crossbreed different kinds of animals. “‘you shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘neither shall there come upon on you a garment made of two kinds of material.

paite: "Kuapeuh sikhanu, apasal ding khamsa nei, tat nai louh, khahkhiak nai louh pasal dang toh lumkhawm peuhmah gawt ding ahi. Himahleh hihlup ding bel ahi kei, amah zalen ahih louh ziak in.
english: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed, or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongpi bul ah TOUPA kiang ah atatlekna thoihna ding in belampa ahon kaih ding ahi.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

paite: Athilhihkhelhsa, akhelhna ah TOUPA ma ah tatlek thoihna belampa in siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia; huchi in athilhihkhelhsa ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahweh for his sin which he has committed: and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

paite: "Gam na va luah ua, nek dia theikung chi chih na suan hun un agah siang lou in na ngai ding uh. Nou a ding in kum thum siang lou a ngaih ding ahi a, nek het louh ding ahi.
english: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. literally, “uncircumcised” Three years shall they be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

paite: Himahleh, akum lina ah agah teng TOUPA phatna ding in amah a dia sehtuam ahi ding hi.
english: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.

paite: Akum ngana ah nou a dia apun zel theihna ding in agah na ne ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Asisan toh khatpeuh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Bum ching in ai na san ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it; neither shall you use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

paite: Na baknel a pan akimvel in na lu na met ding ahi kei. Na khamul lang tuak leng na tan ding ahi sam kei.
english: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your heads, neither shall you clip off the edge of your beard.

paite: Misi ziak in na sa uh na atkeh ding uh ahi kei. Na satung ua gelh in chiamtehna na gelh ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Na tanu kizuaksak ke'n. Gam angkawmna gam ahong suak kha dia, gitlouhna in ahong dim kha ding hi.
english: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

paite: Ka Sabbathte na tan ding uh ahi. Ka mun siangthou na zahtak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.

paite: "Dawi aisan siamte zuan kei unla, bumsiamte leng ahon nitsak-louhna ding un zongkhe kei un. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Lu a kelsam poute ma ah dingh in. Tek omna na zahtak in. Na Pathian lau in. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head, and honor the face of an old man, and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Gamdangmi, na gam ua ana teng a-omleh na hihsiat louh ding uh ahi.
english: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

paite: Gamdangmi na lak ua tengte bel nou a ding in na gam ua mi bang ahi ding ua, nangmah na ki-it bang in amah na it ding ahi. Nou leng Aigupta gam ah gamdangmi na hi ngeita uhi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Vaihawm thu ah, tehna chiang ah, gikdan ah leh saudan tehna ah diktatloupi in na hih ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

paite: Bukna dik, gikdan dik, ephah dik, hin dik na nei ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa ka hi.
english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Ka thupiak tengteng leh ka vaihawm tengteng na pom ding ua, na zuih ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
english: “‘You shall observe all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’”
